summary: Trash System (Papelera) for Schools - All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI verified with screenshots showing archive modal, trash modal, and restore modal working correctly.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing test school 'los gatos'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trash system fully tested. Key features verified: 1) Archive (soft delete) moves school to papelera with status='papelera', previous_status saved, deleted_at timestamp set. 2) Restore brings school back with previous_status. 3) Permanent delete requires school to be in papelera first (409 if not). 4) GET /api/support/schools and /api/support/overview exclude trashed schools. 5) GET /api/support/schools/trash lists trashed schools sorted by deleted_at desc.
